purpose.summary: Integrate the complete continuous native Ergon/Chronik service, historical client profile and Linux hardening in one source/CI milestone.
scope: Exact signed direct-child successor of public f11d867/tree3d59994, with no incoming reports, binaries, operator configuration or private history.
Optional synchronous native journal owns acceptance inputs and immutable block storage metadata;128-event/64MiB service budget includes in-flight leases;failure quarantines only the index.
Atomic live anchoring,ordered upstream writers,source-fenced publication and mempool comparison;DB work and payload destruction outside native validation locks;no coalesced replay after the live cut.

Explicit default-OFF network/genesis-bound main or synthetic-regtest client service,separate read-only shadow profile and index namespaces;loopback only,no pruning,testnet,implicit adoption,wipe or migration.

Existing upstream token/burn verification,HTTP handlers,WS subscriptions,indexer,plugin engine and database;bounded16tx submissions,skip-token/high-fee bypass refused,native absolute fee ceiling retained.
Distinguish accepted/indexed200 from accepted/pending202;WS continuity loss and shutdown close sessions;joined HTTP/Tokio/native users and healthy-stop versus real-corruption distinction.
Historical trusted-plugin commitments have a network-separated domain;the four contributed plugin modules and their protocols are unchanged.
Linux x86_64 assembler noexecstack inputs preserve caller flag precedence;test resulting ELF GNU_STACK rather than mask final linker warnings.

One current-source exact manifest freezes every other parent input;rerun all58predecessor source commands on the exact accepted parent;actual inherited runtime tests always execute the current binary.

Preserve all inherited scenarios,case bodies,prebound assertion counts,repetitions,60second component deadlines and five Linux profiles.Add three-repeat current native groups,synthetic historical clients/reconstruction,and compiled-out journal controls.
CMake/runner full ordered source identities and both profile switches agree;no Rust registry/lock change.One additional actual bundle network-domain unit gives29input/query cases.
Engineering schema gains only an exact explicit network/genesis-bound optional-indexing scope description;all authority/default/mainnet-parameter prohibitions and old records remain unchanged.
exclusions: No consensus,activation,reward,DAA,network identity,testnet rule,wallet,desktop,release or dependency-alert suppression.
No unrelated application source/history,operator identity,endpoint,configuration,datadir,traffic,secret,raw report,build output or binary.
CI and this source record authorize no deployment,cutover or automatic proof promotion;operational qualification and reversible switching remain separate.

limitations: Trusted Python is not a sandbox;pre/post source checks are not an adversarial atomic filesystem snapshot.
Journal and working payload budgets can intentionally close a busy index;this is not a production throughput or availability SLO.
Accepted202 is not a rejected transaction;clients must recover indexed reads and WS state without blind rebroadcast.Notifications are not a durable replay log.
New native assertion counts are strict observed positive summaries repeated three times;inherited prebound assertions and repetitions are unchanged.
Synthetic historical/regtest evidence is not main-chain operational qualification,independent token validation,independent reproduction or production readiness.
Rust registry tuples remain locked;native/system packages,CPython and runner images are not fully locked.No reproducible-build claim.
A fresh exact accepted-GitHub Linux installation,new plugin binding/index qualification,real client/new-block/shutdown checks and preserved rollback are still required before a service switch.
counterevidence: Historical capture/query and stop/reopen timeouts remain open.No component deadline,assertion,repetition or cleanup is weakened,and no failed report is replaced by a diagnostic.

Earlier source candidates failed logger/build-identity checks;their public failures remain visible.The current full ordered-identity regression includes every new journal/WS/service/native hook and both compile switches.

Zero-fee synthetic transactions can be rejected during native LoadMempool if mining cleared their artificial priorities.The test restores declared priority before persistence,never refills or changes native policy after reopen.
Native acceptance can precede indexed availability;200cannot be claimed solely from native submission.Recoverable503/pending202 are not successful empty views.
